phylorug: Visualize Clade Recovery and Support Across Phylogenetic Trees

Source: R/phylorug-package.R
phylorug-package.Rd

Generates rug plot visualizations directly on tree nodes to illustrate clade recovery and support from multiple phylogenetic and phylogenomic analyses. See vignette("phylorug") for a detailed guide.

Core functions

read_trees

Read tree files from disk

translate_tips

Rename specimen codes to species names

check_taxa

Diagnose taxon consistency across trees

prune_to_shared

Prune trees to shared taxa

node_presence_matrix

Make presence/support matrix

plot_phylorug

Draw the rug plot on a reference tree
